flags.message: Decisive forward signal from a companion case: the Court denied certiorari in Curtis v. Inslee, No. 25-1119 (June 1, 2026), the published Ninth Circuit decision this unpublished memorandum rests on entirely, with no response requested and no separate writing; the same order list denied the same counsel's Sweeney (25-1055) and Horsley (25-1203). This predates the snapshot and is not this case's outcome, but it is the largest input to my number, so I record it here.

documents.json shows the petition and QP fetched on 2026-07-18, before the two briefs in opposition (Aug 24) and reply (Sep 14) were filed, so no BIO text was provisioned although the snapshot carries their links. I fetched and read them myself (forward cell). A document refresh when the snapshot is re-provisioned would give every predictor the same opposition text.

The snapshot carries two DISTRIBUTED entries (Jul 1 and Sep 9) for the same 9/28/2026 conference; context.distribution_count is 1. I read the second as a redistribution after the Response Requested/BIO cycle, not a relist, and forecast the relist increment from a one-conference state. Noting so the resolution of relist-increment uses the same reading.
